name: tokenmonitor
description: Registers tokenmonitor-mcp — the local broker for the TokenMonitor ESP32 device. Provides 17 diagnostic and control tools (status/health/logs, device registry + provisioning, WiFi changes, USB serial provisioning, config + firmware OTA staging, revert and update checks) and four on-device skills (/tokenmonitor:configure to pair or reconfigure a device over the LAN or USB, including WiFi changes, /tokenmonitor:settings to remotely change any runtime setting the on-device Settings panel exposes, /tokenmonitor:theme as a shortcut for Day/Night/Auto theme switching, /tokenmonitor:firmware to push an OTA build). Every Codex, Claude Code or Antigravity MCP connection holds a renewable session lease; all sessions share one detached broker daemon, which recovers after a crash and exits after the last lease disappears. Self-contained: bundles the MCP server under server/ and resolves its runtime (Node, Python or Go) on first launch into a per-user cache — no separate go install / pipx / npm step. On a host with no language toolchain it downloads a verified prebuilt Go binary for your platform instead of compiling.
